svg.text: ICT361 - ERD (Student Group Management System) - ict361_db
AI = auto increment. Dashed line = optional or logical link.
2. A group has many students (1:N); group_id NULL = Unassigned.
3. A student has 0..1 account; lecturer accounts have no student.
5. A group receives many requests (1:N), as target or from-group.
6. An account creates many pending operations (1:N).
8. Programmes and groups appear in many timetable slots (optional).
9. claim_codes match students by student_number (no FK).
10. group_requests.resolved_by points to a lecturer account
- Every table has a stable BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT primary key.
- Soft delete: student_number stays reserved after deletion.
- Max 15 active students per group, enforced in a
transaction with SELECT ... FOR UPDATE on the group row.
(same ID, same content = replay; different = reject).
- timetable_slots and faqs are extras, outside the core rules.
- MySQL 8.0.16+, InnoDB, utf8mb4. Fictitious data only.
